title: Velori design exploration starter and static Review continuation
origin: Derived from the approved v1.2.1 native companion; original files preserved.
changes: Starter omits completed Store exercise page and retains four source pages.
Continuation adds selected Review page with restored instances, styled text and variable bindings; no prototype or state wiring.
fontDelivery: No font binaries bundled. The trial loaded Arimo and Lora through Google Fonts.

artifacts.recipientImport: Starter imported into Claude Design; continuation exported from inspected editable native Figma document, fresh recipient Figma import not independently tested.
